opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant £100,000; usual grant range £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research; UK only; must be a strategic institutional priority coordinated by the university Development Office.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and occasionally to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process with two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university in the UK, operating significant scientific or natural history collections of national significance, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for organisations with significant scientific or natural history collections to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces. Two-stage application process with two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance (e.g. Designated Outstanding Collection / Recognised Collection).
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process with two funding rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority in the UK caring for nationally significant collections, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, open and accessible to the public for most of the year.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, usually to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces, with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement. Two-stage application process with two funding rounds per year.
